# Enchantment Differentiation
**A Texture Pack That Changes Textures of Weapons With Specific Enchants!**  

![ED Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83b6d23187e73a9d02bb4512559babe6a32a532e.png)

# Features
- **Knockback 1** - Green outline on Sword handle
- **Knockback 2** - Red outline on Sword handle
- **Breach** - Red outline on Mace 
- **Density** - Blue outline on Mace 
- **Wind Burst** - White mace Topknot

Check Images for preview of these indicators!

# Extra Info
DM me on discord if there are any issues with the pack, my username is hunterleviathan
